summary: Tested per-account state sync (GET/PUT /api/v1/state), cross-device sync, same-browser account isolation, reload + backend-restart persistence, name greeting (Today + AI), Morning briefing error state + refresh, model labels in 6 assistant panels, and quick regression (auth, /auth/me anon 401, AI chat fallback). All requested features work. 16/16 pytest pass (8 new state tests + 8 iteration-1 regression).

minor.issue: Last-write-wins with no optimistic concurrency: client never sends knownVersion, so a stale device/tab that edits pushes its full older snapshot and silently overwrites newer changes from another device (remote is only re-pulled on visibilitychange).

ui_bugs.issue: Badge hardcoded 'GPT 6 Luna' and briefing always calls GPT even when 'LifeOS Local' is selected (inconsistent with ModelLabel feature). Errors are not cached so every Today visit re-calls the OpenAI endpoint.

action_items: Optional: send expected version on PUT /api/v1/state (If-Match / baseVersion) and reject/merge on conflict, or pull before push, to avoid cross-device overwrites
Optional: make briefing badge use ModelLabel / respect selected provider; cache or throttle failed briefing attempts
critical_code_review_comments: account-sync.ts: no conflict detection (see above); periodic or focus-based pull only on visibilitychange.
account-sync.ts endAccountSession: if final push fails, local data is cleared anyway -> last <1.5s of edits lost.
account-sync.ts: on first login with empty remote and no previous owner, anonymous local data is uploaded into the new account (probably intended, but worth confirming).
auth-context.tsx: profile->settings effect runs before async pull; applyRemote then overwrites those settings with the remote envelope's settings (server profile prefs may be ignored).
